properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: Base64 encoded secret key for signing JWTs.

properties.name: jwt.header
properties.description: The HTTP header name used to send the token (e.g., Authorization).

properties.name: jwt.prefix
properties.description: The prefix before the token string (e.g., 'Bearer ').

properties.name: spring.h2.console.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable the H2 console.
